name: Vercel AI Gateway
summary: Vercel AI Gateway is a managed endpoint that gives one API key access to models from many providers. It routes requests across providers, applies provider and model fallbacks, and logs latency, tokens and cost per request. It works from any infrastructure, not only apps deployed on Vercel.
facts: Provider list price, no markup or platform fee on tokens
Yes, no fee; requires purchased credits
AI SDK, OpenAI Chat Completions and Responses, Anthropic Messages
Monthly free credit on a subset of models
Request logs, budgets, OpenTelemetry trace drains (Pro+)
goodFor: Teams already using the AI SDK or Vercel
Spend budgets per project, key or member
watchOut: Free tier limited to some models and lower rate limits
Some controls (ZDR, allowlists, trace drains) cost extra
Hosted only, tied to a Vercel team account
